## BC Assessment

```{r BC Assessment Farm Class}
library(data.table)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Set working directory: SharePoint
setwd("C:/Users/lebautis/Government of BC/SICI Data Library Subsite - Unpublished Data")

# Data loading (sources)
BCA_DF <- fread("2015-2024 BCA Farm Data.csv")
GEO_REF <- fread("GEO_REF.csv")
FARM_USE_REF <- fread("FARM_USE_REF.csv")

## Create 'Final Income' variable
BCA_Farm_Data <- BCA_DF %>% mutate(Final_Income = ifelse(is.na(ADJUSTED_INCOME)==TRUE, 
                                                         REPORTED_INCOME, ADJUSTED_INCOME))

## Aggregate to unique REGID (farm op)
BCA_Farm_Data <- BCA_Farm_Data %>% group_by(TAXYR, REGID, JUR_CODE, FARM_USE_CODE, PRODUCTION_YEAR) %>% 
  summarize(
    Avg_Final_Income = mean(Final_Income),
    Avg_Threshold_Income = mean(THRESHOLD_INCOME),
    Total_Lot_Size_Acres = sum(LOT_SIZE_ACRES),
    Total_Assessed_Land = sum(TOTAL_ASSESSED_LAND)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(Total_Assessed_Land))

## Creating <$10K final income group
BCA_Farm_Data <- BCA_Farm_Data %>% mutate(FINAL_INC_GROUP 
                                          = ifelse(is.na(Avg_Final_Income)==TRUE,NA,
                                                   ifelse(Avg_Final_Income<10000, "<10K",
                                                          ">=10k")))

## Creating <$2.5K final income group
BCA_Farm_Data <- BCA_Farm_Data %>% mutate(FINAL_INC_GROUP2 
                                          = ifelse(is.na(Avg_Final_Income)==TRUE,NA,
                                                   ifelse(Avg_Final_Income<2500, "<2.5K",
                                                          ">=2.5k")))

## Calculated Income Ratio
BCA_Farm_Data <- BCA_Farm_Data %>% mutate(Income_Ratio 
                                          = ifelse(is.na(Avg_Final_Income)==TRUE,NA,
                                                   Avg_Final_Income/Avg_Threshold_Income))


## Creating Land Size group
BCA_Farm_Data <- BCA_Farm_Data %>% mutate(LAND_SIZE_GROUP 
                                          = ifelse(is.na(Total_Lot_Size_Acres)==TRUE,NA,
                                                   ifelse(Total_Lot_Size_Acres>10, ">10",
                                                          ifelse(Total_Lot_Size_Acres>=2, "2 to 10","<2"))))

## Creating Income Ratio group
BCA_Farm_Data <- BCA_Farm_Data %>% mutate(IncomeRatioCount 
                                          = ifelse(is.na(Income_Ratio)==TRUE,NA,
                                                   ifelse(Income_Ratio>=3, ">3",
                                                          ifelse(Income_Ratio>=1, "1 to 3","<1"))))

## Calculate Value per Acre
BCA_Farm_Data <- BCA_Farm_Data %>% mutate(Value_per_acre 
                                          = ifelse(is.na(Total_Assessed_Land)==TRUE,NA,
                                                   Total_Assessed_Land/Total_Lot_Size_Acres))

## Left Join with GEO_REF
BCA_Farm_Data <- BCA_Farm_Data %>% left_join(GEO_REF, by=c("JUR_CODE"), suffix=c("_BCA_Farm_Data", "_GEO_REF"))

## Drop unused columns
BCA_Farm_Data = subset(BCA_Farm_Data, select = -c(AREA_CODE, REG_CODE))

## Left Join with FARM_USE_REF
BCA_Farm_Data <- BCA_Farm_Data %>% left_join(FARM_USE_REF, by=c("FARM_USE_CODE"), suffix=c("_BCA_Farm_Data", "_FARM_USE_REF"))

## Replace Value (NA to "Other")
BCA_Farm_Data <- BCA_Farm_Data %>% 
  mutate(FARM_USE_DESC = ifelse(is.na(FARM_USE_DESC)==TRUE,"Other", FARM_USE_DESC)) %>% 
  mutate(FARM_USE_GROUP = ifelse(is.na(FARM_USE_GROUP)==TRUE,"Other", FARM_USE_GROUP)) %>% 
  mutate(FARM_USE_Sector = ifelse(is.na(FARM_USE_Sector)==TRUE,"Other", FARM_USE_Sector)) 

### Step 2 - Query labeled: Reproduce Power Query tab "Median IR"

## Create 'Final Income' variable
MedianIR <- BCA_DF %>% mutate(Final_Income = ifelse(is.na(ADJUSTED_INCOME)==TRUE, 
                                                    REPORTED_INCOME, ADJUSTED_INCOME))

## Aggregate to unique REGID (farm op)
MedianIR <- MedianIR %>% group_by(TAXYR, REGID, JUR_CODE, FARM_USE_CODE, PRODUCTION_YEAR) %>% 
  summarize(
    Avg_Final_Income = mean(Final_Income),
    Avg_Threshold_Income = mean(THRESHOLD_INCOME),
    Total_Lot_Size_Acres = sum(LOT_SIZE_ACRES),
    Total_Assessed_Land = sum(TOTAL_ASSESSED_LAND)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(Total_Assessed_Land))

## Creating final income group
MedianIR <- MedianIR %>% mutate(FINAL_INC_GROUP 
                                = ifelse(is.na(Avg_Final_Income)==TRUE,NA,
                                         ifelse(Avg_Final_Income<10000, "<10K",
                                                ">=10k")))

## Creating Land Size group
MedianIR <- MedianIR %>% mutate(LAND_SIZE_GROUP 
                                = ifelse(is.na(Total_Lot_Size_Acres)==TRUE,NA,
                                         ifelse(Total_Lot_Size_Acres>10, ">10",
                                                ifelse(Total_Lot_Size_Acres>=2, "2 to 10","<2"))))

## Calculated median final and threshold income
MedianIR <- MedianIR %>% group_by(TAXYR, JUR_CODE, FARM_USE_CODE, FINAL_INC_GROUP, LAND_SIZE_GROUP) %>% 
  summarize(
    Median_Final_Income = median(Avg_Final_Income),
    Median_Threshold_Income = median(Avg_Threshold_Income)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(Median_Final_Income))

## Calculated Income Ratio
MedianIR <- MedianIR %>% mutate(Median_Income_Ratio 
                                = ifelse(is.na(Median_Final_Income)==TRUE,NA,
                                         Median_Final_Income/Median_Threshold_Income))

## Left Join with GEO_REF
MedianIR <- MedianIR %>% left_join(GEO_REF, by=c("JUR_CODE"), suffix=c("_MedianIR", "_GEO_REF"))

## Drop unused columns
MedianIR = subset(MedianIR, select = -c(AREA_CODE, REG_CODE))

## Left Join with FARM_USE_REF
MedianIR <- MedianIR %>% left_join(FARM_USE_REF, by=c("FARM_USE_CODE"), suffix=c("_MedianIR", "_FARM_USE_REF"))

## Replace Value (NA to "Other")
MedianIR <- MedianIR %>% mutate(FARM_USE_DESC = ifelse(is.na(FARM_USE_DESC)==TRUE,"Other", FARM_USE_DESC)) %>% 
  mutate(FARM_USE_GROUP = ifelse(is.na(FARM_USE_GROUP)==TRUE,"Other", FARM_USE_GROUP)) %>% 
  mutate(FARM_USE_Sector = ifelse(is.na(FARM_USE_Sector)==TRUE,"Other", FARM_USE_Sector)) 



```

Count farm operations

```{r}

## Aggregate to unique REGID (farm op)
BCA_FarmOp_Count <- BCA_Farm_Data %>% group_by(TAXYR) %>% 
  summarize(REGID_count = n())

library(ggplot2)

# Plot as a line chart with points and line of best fit
ggplot(BCA_FarmOp_Count, aes(x = TAXYR, y = REGID_count)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, 
              color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Total REGIDs per Year",
    x = "Year (TAXYR)",
    y = "REGID Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
